asr.full_text: Blockchain technology is the innovation that is revolutionizing the financial sector. It allows transactions between two participants without the need for intermediaries to verify them. I believe that the blockchain and the technology, behind which we would call the distributed ledger, would be equivalent to a distributed accounting book. It would be a distributed database replicated among all participants. Validation of data therefore is done by consensus between perfectly identified users. But there are other characteristics. The information from the transactions is grouped in blocks, is immutable and protected in a shared network, can't be erased, and is registered in a history. In addition, blockchain network can be privatised, public or consortium. The conjunction of these concepts makes that blockchain be able to disruption. In smart contracts, there are conditions and terms that can be automatically executed when a condition is met. We add to this the digital signature and also a network with a base of data, which is immutable and which cannot be deleted. This gives us the guarantee that the verified information and the output of this transaction will be the same for both parties, it is neutral. Bonds, shares, registers, properties transfers, certifications, the applications in different sectors are vast but some are leading. Clearly the banks are, I think privileged players for starting to invest in this type of technology. At the end of the day, the intermediation platforms of the banks themselves are very powerful, not only with particular clients, but also and above all between the banks themselves, the interbanking markets. Grand Thornton experts believe that, more than disappearing, Blockchain will allow the financial sector to explore new niches and market areas. We have been doing follow-up on the development of this not only in Spain but worldwide, even in collaborative work agreements and joint work with start up companies which are working on these issues around the world, We are privileged to investigate with our clients and with company with which we work and companies with we usually work with or other companies that we haven't had the chance to work with yet to help them explore possible developments and possible uses of this new technology and to learn how to apply it in their day-to-day businesses.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining a OneCoin team as a way to achieve goals and displays a WhatsApp contact overlay that may provide a route for follow-up. Much of the material also presents blockchain as an educational or business topic, and the available video evidence does not establish a payment request, victim loss, or a confirmed connection between the OneCoin wording and the Grant Thornton discussion.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The explicit invitation to join a OneCoin team supports a recruitment-focused mechanism. The available evidence does not establish downlines, tiers, matrices, commissions, or paid expansion, so the fit is limited to the observed team-recruitment invitation.
